GO
CREATE PROC  SP_InsertOrUpdate_GvrTemporaryRegistrationKey
@GvrTemporaryRegistrationKeyId bigint,
@CreationDate datetime = NULL,
@ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@TemporaryRegistrationKey int = NULL,
@ExpirationDate datetime = NULL,
@GvrCabinetId bigint = NULL,
@OperatorNumber bigint = NULL,
@IsUsed int = NULL,
@Status char (2) = NULL,
@GvrCabinetLocationId bigint = NULL,
@GvrOperatorId bigint = NULL

AS

IF (
(
	SELECT	COUNT(*)
	FROM	GvrTemporaryRegistrationKey
	WHERE	GvrTemporaryRegistrationKeyId = @GvrTemporaryRegistrationKeyId
) > 0)
EXEC SP_Update_GvrTemporaryRegistrationKey	@GvrTemporaryRegistrationKeyId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @TemporaryRegistrationKey, @ExpirationDate, @GvrCabinetId, @OperatorNumber, @IsUsed, @Status, @GvrCabinetLocationId, @GvrOperatorId

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_GvrTemporaryRegistrationKey	@GvrTemporaryRegistrationKeyId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @TemporaryRegistrationKey, @ExpirationDate, @GvrCabinetId, @OperatorNumber, @IsUsed, @Status, @GvrCabinetLocationId, @GvrOperatorId
GO

@GvrOperatorId bigint,
@CreationDate datetime = NULL,
@ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@OperatorNumber bigint = NULL,
@Status char (2) = NULL,
@MembershipLevel int = NULL,
@FullName varchar (128) = NULL,
@Role int = NULL,
@Email varchar (128) = NULL,
@Title varchar (50) = NULL,
@PhoneWork varchar (50) = NULL,
@PhoneHome varchar (50) = NULL,
@PhoneCell varchar (50) = NULL,
@PhoneContact varchar (50) = NULL,
@Fax varchar (50) = NULL,
@Street1 varchar (80) = NULL,
@Street2 varchar (80) = NULL,
@Street3 varchar (80) = NULL,
@City varchar (50) = NULL,
@State varchar (50) = NULL,
@PostalCode varchar (50) = NULL,
@CountryCode char (2) = NULL,
@WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed int = NULL,
@WebIsMailDistributionAllowed int = NULL

AS

(
	SELECT	COUNT(*)
	FROM	GvrOperator
	WHERE	GvrOperatorId = @GvrOperatorId

GO

ALTER TABLE [GvrOperator] ADD 
CONSTRAINT [DF_GvrOperator_OperatorNumber] DEFAULT (0) FOR [OperatorNumber]
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE name = 'GvrOperator_InsertTrigger' AND type = 'TR')
DROP TRIGGER GvrOperator_InsertTrigger
GO
Create TRIGGER GvrOperator_InsertTrigger ON GvrOperator
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
Begin
    Declare @GvrOperatorId bigint, @CreationDate datetime, @ModifiedDate bigint, @PropagationDate bigint, @OperatorNumber bigint, @Status char (2), @MembershipLevel int, @FullName varchar (128), @Role int, @Email varchar (128), @Title varchar (50), @PhoneWork varchar (50), @PhoneHome varchar (50), @PhoneCell varchar (50), @PhoneContact varchar (50), @Fax varchar (50), @Street1 varchar (80), @Street2 varchar (80), @Street3 varchar (80), @City varchar (50), @State varchar (50), @PostalCode varchar (50), @CountryCode char (2), @WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed int, @WebIsMailDistributionAllowed int
    Declare InsertedCursor Cursor For Select GvrOperatorId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,OperatorNumber,Status,MembershipLevel,FullName,Role,Email,Title,PhoneWork,PhoneHome,PhoneCell,PhoneContact,Fax,Street1,Street2,Street3,City,State,PostalCode,CountryCode,WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed,WebIsMailDistributionAllowed
    From inserted
    For Read Only
    Open InsertedCursor
    Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrOperatorId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorNumber,@Status,@MembershipLevel,@FullName,@Role,@Email,@Title,@PhoneWork,@PhoneHome,@PhoneCell,@PhoneContact,@Fax,@Street1,@Street2,@Street3,@City,@State,@PostalCode,@CountryCode,@WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed,@WebIsMailDistributionAllowed
    -- Go through each row, one by one
    While (@@Fetch_status=0)
    Begin
        If @OperatorNumber is null OR @OperatorNumber = 0
        Begin
            Select @OperatorNumber = Max(OperatorNumber)
            From GvrOperator
            If @OperatorNumber is null
            Begin
                Set @OperatorNumber = 0 --DefaultSeed
            End
            Else
            Begin
                Set @OperatorNumber = @OperatorNumber + 1 
            End
        End
        Insert Into GvrOperator
               (GvrOperatorId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,OperatorNumber,Status,MembershipLevel,FullName,Role,Email,Title,PhoneWork,PhoneHome,PhoneCell,PhoneContact,Fax,Street1,Street2,Street3,City,State,PostalCode,CountryCode,WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed,WebIsMailDistributionAllowed)
        Values (@GvrOperatorId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorNumber,@Status,@MembershipLevel,@FullName,@Role,@Email,@Title,@PhoneWork,@PhoneHome,@PhoneCell,@PhoneContact,@Fax,@Street1,@Street2,@Street3,@City,@State,@PostalCode,@CountryCode,@WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed,@WebIsMailDistributionAllowed)
        Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrOperatorId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorNumber,@Status,@MembershipLevel,@FullName,@Role,@Email,@Title,@PhoneWork,@PhoneHome,@PhoneCell,@PhoneContact,@Fax,@Street1,@Street2,@Street3,@City,@State,@PostalCode,@CountryCode,@WebIsEmailNotificationAllowed,@WebIsMailDistributionAllowed
    End
    Close InsertedCursor
    Deallocate InsertedCursor
End
GO

@ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@CabinetId bigint = NULL,

@GvrIspAccountId bigint = NULL,
@WebCanSearch int = NULL

AS

IF (
(
	SELECT	COUNT(*)
	FROM	GvrCabinet
	WHERE	GvrCabinetId = @GvrCabinetId
) > 0)
EXEC SP_Update_GvrCabinet	@GvrCabinetId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @CabinetId, @OperatorNumber, @DongleNumber, @SerialNumber, @GameTitle, @GameVersion, @CabinetNumber, @Status, @GvrCabinetLocationId, @CabinetPWD, @GvrOperatorId, @GvrIspAccountId, @WebCanSearch

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_GvrCabinet	@GvrCabinetId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @CabinetId, @OperatorNumber, @DongleNumber, @SerialNumber, @GameTitle, @GameVersion, @CabinetNumber, @Status, @GvrCabinetLocationId, @CabinetPWD, @GvrOperatorId, @GvrIspAccountId, @WebCanSearch
GO

ALTER TABLE [GvrCabinet] ADD 
CONSTRAINT [DF_GvrCabinet_CabinetNumber] DEFAULT (15000) FOR [CabinetNumber],
CONSTRAINT [DF_GvrCabinet_WebCanSearch] DEFAULT (1) FOR [WebCanSearch]
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE name = 'GvrCabinet_InsertTrigger' AND type = 'TR')
DROP TRIGGER GvrCabinet_InsertTrigger
GO
Create TRIGGER GvrCabinet_InsertTrigger ON GvrCabinet
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
Begin
    Declare @GvrCabinetId bigint, @CreationDate datetime, @ModifiedDate bigint, @PropagationDate bigint, @CabinetId bigint, @OperatorNumber bigint, @DongleNumber bigint, @SerialNumber varchar (50), @GameTitle varchar (50), @GameVersion varchar (50), @CabinetNumber bigint, @Status char (2), @GvrCabinetLocationId bigint, @CabinetPWD varchar (50), @GvrOperatorId bigint, @GvrIspAccountId bigint, @WebCanSearch int
    Declare InsertedCursor Cursor For Select GvrCabinetId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,CabinetId,OperatorNumber,DongleNumber,SerialNumber,GameTitle,GameVersion,CabinetNumber,Status,GvrCabinetLocationId,CabinetPWD,GvrOperatorId,GvrIspAccountId,WebCanSearch
    From inserted
    For Read Only
    Open InsertedCursor
    Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrCabinetId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@CabinetId,@OperatorNumber,@DongleNumber,@SerialNumber,@GameTitle,@GameVersion,@CabinetNumber,@Status,@GvrCabinetLocationId,@CabinetPWD,@GvrOperatorId,@GvrIspAccountId,@WebCanSearch
    -- Go through each row, one by one
    While (@@Fetch_status=0)
    Begin
        If @CabinetNumber is null OR @CabinetNumber = 0
        Begin
            Select @CabinetNumber = Max(CabinetNumber)
            From GvrCabinet
            If @CabinetNumber is null
            Begin
                Set @CabinetNumber = 15000 --DefaultSeed
            End
            Else
            Begin
                Set @CabinetNumber = @CabinetNumber + 1 
            End
        End
        Insert Into GvrCabinet
               (GvrCabinetId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,CabinetId,OperatorNumber,DongleNumber,SerialNumber,GameTitle,GameVersion,CabinetNumber,Status,GvrCabinetLocationId,CabinetPWD,GvrOperatorId,GvrIspAccountId,WebCanSearch)
        Values (@GvrCabinetId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@CabinetId,@OperatorNumber,@DongleNumber,@SerialNumber,@GameTitle,@GameVersion,@CabinetNumber,@Status,@GvrCabinetLocationId,@CabinetPWD,@GvrOperatorId,@GvrIspAccountId,@WebCanSearch)
        Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrCabinetId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@CabinetId,@OperatorNumber,@DongleNumber,@SerialNumber,@GameTitle,@GameVersion,@CabinetNumber,@Status,@GvrCabinetLocationId,@CabinetPWD,@GvrOperatorId,@GvrIspAccountId,@WebCanSearch
    End
    Close InsertedCursor
    Deallocate InsertedCursor
End
GO

ALTER TABLE [GvrCabinetSyncLog] ADD 
CONSTRAINT [DF_GvrCabinetSyncLog_SequenceNumber] DEFAULT (0) FOR [SequenceNumber]
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE name = 'GvrCabinetSyncLog_InsertTrigger' AND type = 'TR')
DROP TRIGGER GvrCabinetSyncLog_InsertTrigger
GO
Create TRIGGER GvrCabinetSyncLog_InsertTrigger ON GvrCabinetSyncLog
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
Begin
    Declare @GvrCabinetSyncLogId bigint, @CreationDate datetime, @ModifiedDate bigint, @PropagationDate bigint, @SyncStartTime datetime, @SyncEndTime datetime, @SyncStatus char (2), @SyncLog varchar (2000), @SyncErrorCode int, @SequenceNumber bigint
    Declare InsertedCursor Cursor For Select GvrCabinetSyncLogId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,SyncStartTime,SyncEndTime,SyncStatus,SyncLog,SyncErrorCode,SequenceNumber
    From inserted
    For Read Only
    Open InsertedCursor
    Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrCabinetSyncLogId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@SyncStartTime,@SyncEndTime,@SyncStatus,@SyncLog,@SyncErrorCode,@SequenceNumber
    -- Go through each row, one by one
    While (@@Fetch_status=0)
    Begin
        If @SequenceNumber is null OR @SequenceNumber = 0
        Begin
            Select @SequenceNumber = Max(SequenceNumber)
            From GvrCabinetSyncLog
            If @SequenceNumber is null
            Begin
                Set @SequenceNumber = 0 --DefaultSeed
            End
            Else
            Begin
                Set @SequenceNumber = @SequenceNumber + 1 
            End
        End
        Insert Into GvrCabinetSyncLog
               (GvrCabinetSyncLogId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,SyncStartTime,SyncEndTime,SyncStatus,SyncLog,SyncErrorCode,SequenceNumber)
        Values (@GvrCabinetSyncLogId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@SyncStartTime,@SyncEndTime,@SyncStatus,@SyncLog,@SyncErrorCode,@SequenceNumber)
        Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @GvrCabinetSyncLogId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@SyncStartTime,@SyncEndTime,@SyncStatus,@SyncLog,@SyncErrorCode,@SequenceNumber
    End
    Close InsertedCursor
    Deallocate InsertedCursor
End
GO

EXEC SP_Update_UpchargePricing	@UpchargePricingId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @Price, @CurrencyId, @Percentage, @PricingModelId, @ProductDefinitionId, @EffectiveStart, @EffectiveEnd, @PricingStatus, @PartnerPercentage, @PartnerAmount, @PartnerType, @PricingType, @CollectionCategory, @LedgerCategory, @VolumeDiscountCode

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_UpchargePricing	@UpchargePricingId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @Price, @CurrencyId, @Percentage, @PricingModelId, @ProductDefinitionId, @EffectiveStart, @EffectiveEnd, @PricingStatus, @PartnerPercentage, @PartnerAmount, @PartnerType, @PricingType, @CollectionCategory, @LedgerCategory, @VolumeDiscountCode
GO

ALTER TABLE [UpchargePricing] ADD 
CONSTRAINT [DF_UpchargePricing_VolumeDiscountCode] DEFAULT ('NO') FOR [VolumeDiscountCode]
GO

EXEC SP_Update_RevenueShare	@RevenueShareId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @OperatorId, @Cabinet, @DongleId, @OnlineIncluded, @SoftwareIncluded, @MonthlySoftwareFee, @MonthlyFee, @MonthlyMinimum, @Percentage, @LedgerCategory, @Active

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_RevenueShare	@RevenueShareId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @OperatorId, @Cabinet, @DongleId, @OnlineIncluded, @SoftwareIncluded, @MonthlySoftwareFee, @MonthlyFee, @MonthlyMinimum, @Percentage, @LedgerCategory, @Active
GO

@Amount float = NULL,
@AmountOutstanding float = NULL,
@AmountOnline float = NULL,
@AmountRevShare float = NULL,
@AmountOther float = NULL,
@AmountTotalEarnings float = NULL,
@InvoiceDate datetime = NULL,
@InvoiceStatus char (2) = NULL,
@GPReference bigint = NULL,
@DueDate datetime = NULL,
@CurrencyId bigint = NULL,
@RegionId bigint = NULL,
@MonthEndId bigint = NULL,
@CabinetCount int = NULL,
@CategoryCount int = NULL,
@DistributorAmount float = NULL,
@InvoiceNumber bigint = NULL

AS

IF (
(
	SELECT	COUNT(*)
	FROM	Invoice
	WHERE	InvoiceId = @InvoiceId
) > 0)
EXEC SP_Update_Invoice	@InvoiceId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @OperatorId, @Amount, @AmountOutstanding, @AmountOnline, @AmountRevShare, @AmountOther, @AmountTotalEarnings, @InvoiceDate, @InvoiceStatus, @GPReference, @DueDate, @CurrencyId, @RegionId, @MonthEndId, @CabinetCount, @CategoryCount, @DistributorAmount, @InvoiceNumber

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_Invoice	@InvoiceId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @OperatorId, @Amount, @AmountOutstanding, @AmountOnline, @AmountRevShare, @AmountOther, @AmountTotalEarnings, @InvoiceDate, @InvoiceStatus, @GPReference, @DueDate, @CurrencyId, @RegionId, @MonthEndId, @CabinetCount, @CategoryCount, @DistributorAmount, @InvoiceNumber
GO

ALTER TABLE [Invoice] ADD 
CONSTRAINT [DF_Invoice_Amount] DEFAULT (0.0) FOR [Amount],
CONSTRAINT [DF_Invoice_InvoiceNumber] DEFAULT (300000) FOR [InvoiceNumber]
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE name = 'Invoice_InsertTrigger' AND type = 'TR')
DROP TRIGGER Invoice_InsertTrigger
GO
Create TRIGGER Invoice_InsertTrigger ON Invoice
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
Begin
    Declare @InvoiceId bigint, @CreationDate datetime, @ModifiedDate bigint, @PropagationDate bigint, @OperatorId bigint, @Amount float, @AmountOutstanding float, @AmountOnline float, @AmountRevShare float, @AmountOther float, @AmountTotalEarnings float, @InvoiceDate datetime, @InvoiceStatus char (2), @GPReference bigint, @DueDate datetime, @CurrencyId bigint, @RegionId bigint, @MonthEndId bigint, @CabinetCount int, @CategoryCount int, @DistributorAmount float, @InvoiceNumber bigint
    Declare InsertedCursor Cursor For Select InvoiceId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,OperatorId,Amount,AmountOutstanding,AmountOnline,AmountRevShare,AmountOther,AmountTotalEarnings,InvoiceDate,InvoiceStatus,GPReference,DueDate,CurrencyId,RegionId,MonthEndId,CabinetCount,CategoryCount,DistributorAmount,InvoiceNumber
    From inserted
    For Read Only
    Open InsertedCursor
    Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @InvoiceId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorId,@Amount,@AmountOutstanding,@AmountOnline,@AmountRevShare,@AmountOther,@AmountTotalEarnings,@InvoiceDate,@InvoiceStatus,@GPReference,@DueDate,@CurrencyId,@RegionId,@MonthEndId,@CabinetCount,@CategoryCount,@DistributorAmount,@InvoiceNumber
    -- Go through each row, one by one
    While (@@Fetch_status=0)
    Begin
        If @InvoiceNumber is null OR @InvoiceNumber = 0
        Begin
            Select @InvoiceNumber = Max(InvoiceNumber)
            From Invoice
            If @InvoiceNumber is null
            Begin
                Set @InvoiceNumber = 300000 --DefaultSeed
            End
            Else
            Begin
                Set @InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber + 1 
            End
        End
        Insert Into Invoice
               (InvoiceId,CreationDate,ModifiedDate,PropagationDate,OperatorId,Amount,AmountOutstanding,AmountOnline,AmountRevShare,AmountOther,AmountTotalEarnings,InvoiceDate,InvoiceStatus,GPReference,DueDate,CurrencyId,RegionId,MonthEndId,CabinetCount,CategoryCount,DistributorAmount,InvoiceNumber)
        Values (@InvoiceId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorId,@Amount,@AmountOutstanding,@AmountOnline,@AmountRevShare,@AmountOther,@AmountTotalEarnings,@InvoiceDate,@InvoiceStatus,@GPReference,@DueDate,@CurrencyId,@RegionId,@MonthEndId,@CabinetCount,@CategoryCount,@DistributorAmount,@InvoiceNumber)
        Fetch Next From InsertedCursor Into @InvoiceId,@CreationDate,@ModifiedDate,@PropagationDate,@OperatorId,@Amount,@AmountOutstanding,@AmountOnline,@AmountRevShare,@AmountOther,@AmountTotalEarnings,@InvoiceDate,@InvoiceStatus,@GPReference,@DueDate,@CurrencyId,@RegionId,@MonthEndId,@CabinetCount,@CategoryCount,@DistributorAmount,@InvoiceNumber
    End
    Close InsertedCursor
    Deallocate InsertedCursor
End
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_InsertOrUpdate_CabinetStatus_NFS1
@CabinetStatusId bigint,
@CreationDate datetime = NULL,
@ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@CabinetId bigint = NULL,
@GameVersion varchar (16) = NULL,
@NytricVersion int = NULL,
@RedDotEnabled int = NULL,
@SmartCardReaderStatus int = NULL,

@OperatorButtonBad int = NULL,
@ShifterBad int = NULL,
@BrakeBad int = NULL,
@GasBad int = NULL,
@SteeringBad int = NULL,
@Status1 int = NULL,
@Status2 int = NULL

AS

(
	SELECT	COUNT(*)
	FROM	CabinetStatus_NFS1
	WHERE	CabinetStatusId = @CabinetStatusId
) > 0)
EXEC SP_Update_CabinetStatus_NFS1	@CabinetStatusId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @CabinetId, @GameVersion, @NytricVersion, @RedDotEnabled, @SmartCardReaderStatus, @CardDispenserStatus, @LookbackButtonBad, @MusicButtonBad, @NitroButtonBad, @StartButtonBad, @ViewButtonBad, @EBrakeButtonBad, @OperatorButtonBad, @ShifterBad, @BrakeBad, @GasBad, @SteeringBad, @Status1, @Status2

ELSE
EXEC SP_Insert_CabinetStatus_NFS1	@CabinetStatusId, @CreationDate, @ModifiedDate, @PropagationDate, @CabinetId, @GameVersion, @NytricVersion, @RedDotEnabled, @SmartCardReaderStatus, @CardDispenserStatus, @LookbackButtonBad, @MusicButtonBad, @NitroButtonBad, @StartButtonBad, @ViewButtonBad, @EBrakeButtonBad, @OperatorButtonBad, @ShifterBad, @BrakeBad, @GasBad, @SteeringBad, @Status1, @Status2
GO

CREATE PROC SP_UpdateDepth_GvrPatchLog @GvrPatchLog_GvrPatchLogId bigint,
@GvrPatchLog_CreationDate datetime = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_CabinetId bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_GvrPatchServiceId bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_PatchStatus char (2) = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_PatchLog varchar (1000) = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_DRC int = NULL,
@GvrPatchLog_ERC int = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_GvrPatchServiceId bigint,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_CreationDate datetime = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_ModifiedDate bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PropagationDate bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PatchName varchar (100) = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PatchURL varchar (256) = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_FilterType varchar (200) = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_FilterValue varchar (2000) = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PatchSize bigint = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PatchHash varchar (200) = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_IsActive int = NULL,
@GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_PatchDescription varchar (1000) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
Begin Transaction

UPDATE GvrPatchLog
SET CreationDate = @GvrPatchLog_CreationDate,
ModifiedDate = @GvrPatchLog_ModifiedDate,

SET CreationDate = @GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_CreationDate,
ModifiedDate = @GvrPatchService_GvrPatchServiceId_ModifiedDate,

WHERE CarTweaksId = @CarTweaks_NFS1_CarTweaksId_CarTweaksId

UPDATE CarConfiguration_NFS1
SET CreationDate = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_CreationDate,

GvrKitId_Brakelight = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_GvrKitId_Brakelight,

GvrKitId_WindowTint = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_GvrKitId_WindowTint,
GvrKitId_Neon = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_GvrKitId_Neon,
GvrKitId_HoodDecal = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_GvrKitId_HoodDecal,

GvrPup_Brakes = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_GvrPup_Brakes
WHERE CarConfigurationId = @CarConfiguration_NFS1_CarConfigurationId_CarConfigurationId

If @@Error <> 0 goto PROBLEM 
SUCCEED:
Commit Transaction 
Return 0 
PROBLEM:
Rollback Transaction 
Return -1 
END
GO
CREATE TABLE [GlobalVariable] 
(
[GlobalVariableId] [bigint] NOT NULL , 
[VariableName] [varchar] (64) ,
[VariableValue] [varchar] (2048),
[ModifiedDate] [bigint] 
)
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_GetSet_GlobalVariable 
AS 
SELECT * FROM GlobalVariable 
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_Get_GlobalVariable 
@GlobalVariableId bigint 
AS
SELECT * FROM GlobalVariable 
WHERE GlobalVariableId = @GlobalVariableId 
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_Insert_GlobalVariable 
@GlobalVariableId bigint,
@VariableName varchar (64),
@VariableValue varchar (2048),
@ModifiedDate bigint 
AS
INSERT INTO GlobalVariable (GlobalVariableId, VariableName, VariableValue, ModifiedDate) VALUES (@GlobalVariableId, @VariableName, @VariableValue, @ModifiedDate)
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_Update_GlobalVariable 
@GlobalVariableId bigint, 
@VariableName varchar (64),
@VariableValue varchar (2048),
@ModifiedDate bigint 
AS
UPDATE GlobalVariable 
SET VariableName = @VariableName,
VariableValue = @VariableValue,
ModifiedDate = @ModifiedDate
WHERE GlobalVariableId = @GlobalVariableId
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_InsertOrUpdate_GlobalVariable 
@GlobalVariableId bigint,
@VariableName varchar (64),
@VariableValue varchar (2048),
@ModifiedDate bigint 
AS
IF ( ( SELECT	COUNT(*) FROM GlobalVariable WHERE GlobalVariableId = @GlobalVariableId ) > 0) 
    EXEC SP_Update_GlobalVariable @GlobalVariableId, @VariableName, @VariableValue, @ModifiedDate
ELSE
    EXEC SP_Insert_GlobalVariable @GlobalVariableId, @VariableName, @VariableValue, @ModifiedDate
GO

CREATE PROC  SP_Delete_GlobalVariable 
@GlobalVariableId bigint 
AS
DELETE GlobalVariable 
WHERE GlobalVariableId = @GlobalVariableId 
GO
